name: GD AI 2 Bridge
description: Turns a level into a lockstep RL environment: the game only advances when the Python agent sends an action.

agent-control.name: Agent control
agent-control.description: When on and the Python trainer is running, the agent drives the game (lockstep). Turn off to play normally.

steps-per-frame.name: Agent steps per frame
steps-per-frame.description: Maximum agent steps processed per rendered frame. Higher = faster than real time training.
